title: Oldest-age sampler gauge frozen for one hour

model.expr: (count(omi_batch_projection_obligation_oldest_age_seconds > 0 and (max_over_time(omi_batch_projection_obligation_oldest_age_seconds[1h]) - min_over_time(omi_batch_projection_obligation_oldest_age_seconds[1h]) == 0) and (time() - min_over_time(timestamp(omi_batch_projection_obligation_oldest_age_seconds)[1h:1m]) >= 3300)) or vector(0)) + (count(omi_batch_pipeline_vendor_held_oldest_age_seconds > 0 and (max_over_time(omi_batch_pipeline_vendor_held_oldest_age_seconds[1h]) - min_over_time(omi_batch_pipeline_vendor_held_oldest_age_seconds[1h]) == 0) and (time() - min_over_time(timestamp(omi_batch_pipeline_vendor_held_oldest_age_seconds)[1h:1m]) >= 3300)) or vector(0)) + (count(omi_summary_debt_oldest_age_seconds > 0 and (max_over_time(omi_summary_debt_oldest_age_seconds[1h]) - min_over_time(omi_summary_debt_oldest_age_seconds[1h]) == 0) and (time() - min_over_time(timestamp(omi_summary_debt_oldest_age_seconds)[1h:1m]) >= 3300) and (time() - omi_summary_debt_sample_timestamp_seconds < 300)) or vector(0)) + (count(omi_demand_processing_queue_age_seconds > 0 and (max_over_time(omi_demand_processing_queue_age_seconds[1h]) - min_over_time(omi_demand_processing_queue_age_seconds[1h]) == 0) and (time() - min_over_time(timestamp(omi_demand_processing_queue_age_seconds)[1h:1m]) >= 3300)) or vector(0))

annotations.summary: A positive oldest-age gauge is constant across a one-hour window with at least 55 minutes of per-series observation history.
annotations.user_impact: Frozen metrics can hide delayed batch publication or demand processing and mislead backlog triage.
annotations.scope: Per-series projection obligation, vendor-held, summary-debt and demand-processing ages. Each series needs an observation at least 3300s old in its 1h window; a 1m timestamp subquery tolerates scrape cadence without assuming a sample count. Zero ages, absent emitters and short histories contribute zero. Summary ages require the matching replica sample to be younger than 300s. Agent-tier telemetry warning; no lifecycle consumer.
annotations.verification: Check the emitting pod and its supervised tick logs. Compare max_over_time minus min_over_time over 1h per series and confirm time() minus min_over_time(timestamp(age)[1h:1m]) is at least 3300s; never borrow history across replicas. Verify omi_batch_projection_obligation_observed_at_seconds and the existing omi-batch-queue-safety-blind rule on omi_batch_pipeline_metrics_refreshed_at_seconds; timeliness sample-stale owns fresh-gated ages. Exclude summary replicas whose omi_summary_debt_sample_timestamp_seconds is absent or at least 300s old. Summary producer absence/staleness is separate enablement-aware alert debt, not a failure in this rule.
annotations.safe_next_action: Check the emitting pod's supervised tick logs; restart the pod; confirm the gauge resumes changing. This alert authorizes no runtime changes beyond a pod restart.
annotations.threshold: $A > 0 for 10m; positive per-series age constant over 1h with at least 3300s observation history; summary replica sample younger than 300s
annotations.evaluated_bad: Positive age with max_over_time equal to min_over_time over 1h and a timestamp observation at least 3300s old in that window; summary ages also require a fresh matching sampler.
annotations.evaluated_good: Zero or changing age, fewer than 55 minutes of series history, or absent emitter contributes zero. Stale/absent summary samples are excluded, not proof of healthy summary repair.
